_comment: Derived journal Leads: un-started mainline hooks whose prerequisites are met. Pure counter reads; a lead vanishes when its hide_when (the quest-start counter) banks. Every row MIRRORS its target dialogue option's own requires/hide_when exactly -- a lead that fires one waking early points at a refusal. v0.15 spec A2.

leads.lead_text: The Guild posted a Watch notice about the reopened gallery.
Ceria's been planning a dig east past the floodplains.
Pisces keeps looking at the Door like it owes him a letter.
Eloise has been eyeing the way you arrived.
Hedault keeps stopping mid-appraisal when your Door comes up.
Grimalkin has been about to say something since your papers were stamped.
The headman is still recounting a ledger that will not add up.
The hunter has been watching the treeline instead of the fields.

leads._comment: GH#334 notes 21/22. Mirrors the shop gate: hub arm requires blight_lifted, stone row hides on invrisil_attuned.
leads.lead_text: Eloise keeps a stone under the cloth that already knows the road to Invrisil.
A letter signed with a drawn hat wants a stranger's help in Invrisil, and says the witch keeps the stones.
A woman has been sitting in the stationer's for an hour holding a closed box.
Wilovan has an errand that wants a quiet pair of hands.
The smith's reject bin is filling up with work that should have passed.
One crate of tin has been held on the landing manifest three cycles running.
Rags stood on the rise the whole time you were leaving, and did not sit down.
